instruction: Create a new metric IFC4 single-storey bungalow in Bonsai and save it as result.ifc. Start from a blank project; no init_file inputs or reference images are provided. The model should contain one project, one site, one building, one building storey named Bungalow Level, five spaces, seven walls, three slabs, one door, four windows, five opening elements, five void relationships, and five fill relationships. Do not use building element proxies, furniture, roofs, columns, beams, stairs, or flow terminals, and keep all IfcRoot GlobalId values unique. Name the spaces Living, Kitchen, Bed 1, Bed 2, and Bath. Their world-coordinate plan spans should be Living 5.80 m by 3.00 m, Kitchen 2.80 m by 3.00 m, Bed 1 2.80 m by 2.60 m, Bed 2 3.00 m by 2.60 m, and Bath 2.80 m by 2.60 m, each within about 0.10 m. Name the slabs Main Slab, Main Roof, and Porch Canopy. Place Main Roof with minimum world Z at least 3.00 m, and place Porch Canopy with minimum world Z at least 2.50 m and minimum world Y below 0.00 m. Each wall should be 3.00 m high within about 0.10 m. Add an Entrance Door with OverallWidth 0.90 m in South Wall. Add Kitchen Window, Bed1 Window, Bed2 Window, and Bath Window, each with OverallWidth 1.20 m; host them in separate wall openings in East Wall, North Wall, North Wall, and North Wall respectively. Other details may vary.
